title: Event Details

fields.label: Event Type
fields.name: event_type
fields.instructions: Choose the type first. The form will show only the details that apply.

fields.label: Organizer
fields.name: event_organizer
fields.instructions: Select the town body, office, service, or community organization responsible for this event.

fields.label: Location
fields.name: event_location
fields.instructions: Choose a saved location. Add and manage locations from the Events menu.

fields.label: Short Description
fields.name: short_description
fields.instructions: A brief plain-language summary for calendar lists and popovers.

fields.label: Contact
fields.name: contact
fields.instructions: Enter the best public contact for questions about this event.

fields.label: Create a Landing Page
fields.name: has_landing_page
fields.instructions: Turn this on only when the event needs a full page with additional details.

fields.label: Date and time
fields.message: Set when the event starts and ends.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.name: start_date
fields.instructions: For a repeating event, this is the first occurrence date.

fields.label: End Date
fields.name: end_date
fields.instructions: Leave blank when the event ends on the start date.

fields.label: All day
fields.name: all_day
fields.instructions: Choose this when no start or end time should be shown.

fields.label: Repeat
fields.name: recurrence_pattern
fields.instructions: Choose the option that best matches the schedule. Select Custom when you need a different interval, weekdays, or monthly rule.

fields.label: Custom recurrence
fields.message: Set the interval, days, monthly rule, and when the series ends.

fields.label: Repeat monthly by
fields.name: recurrence_monthly_basis
fields.instructions: Use the event start date as the reference. For example, choose the same weekday position for the first Thursday of each month.

choices.day_of_month: The same numbered day of the month
choices.weekday_position: The same weekday position in the month

fields.label: End date
fields.name: recurrence_end_date
fields.instructions: The last date that may contain an occurrence.

fields.label: Number of occurrences
fields.name: recurrence_end_count
fields.instructions: Count the first occurrence on the start date.

fields.label: Selected dates
fields.message: Add dates that do not follow a regular pattern.

fields.label: Additional dates
fields.name: selected_dates
fields.instructions: The Start Date above is the first occurrence. Add each additional date in the series.

fields.label: Changes to individual dates
fields.message: Cancel, reschedule, move, or add a public note to one occurrence without changing the rest of the series.

fields.label: Changed dates
fields.name: occurrence_exceptions
fields.instructions: Add only the date that changes. The original repeating schedule remains intact.

choices.rescheduled: Rescheduled to another date or time

sub_fields.label: Public Note
sub_fields.name: note
sub_fields.instructions: For example: Cancelled due to weather.

sub_fields.label: New Location
sub_fields.name: new_location
sub_fields.instructions: Select the location where this occurrence will be held instead.

fields.label: Meeting records by date
fields.message: Attach public notice status, an agenda, and minutes to a specific occurrence in a repeating meeting series.

fields.label: Meeting records by date
fields.name: occurrence_meeting_records
fields.instructions: For a repeating meeting, add one row for each occurrence that needs its own public notice status, agenda, or minutes. The recurrence schedule creates the dates; these rows attach records to a scheduled date.

sub_fields.label: Meeting Date
sub_fields.name: date
sub_fields.instructions: Choose a date generated by this event's recurrence schedule.

sub_fields.label: Public Notice Status
sub_fields.name: warning_status
sub_fields.instructions: Indicate whether the legally required meeting notice and agenda have been posted. Review the Vermont Open Meeting Law and Town Meeting warning requirements.

sub_fields.label: Agenda
sub_fields.name: agenda
sub_fields.instructions: Choose one source. Before publication, confirm the public document is accessible or provide an equivalent accessible path.

sub_fields.label: Minutes
sub_fields.name: minutes
sub_fields.instructions: Choose one source. Before publication, confirm the public document is accessible or provide an equivalent accessible path.

fields.label: Public Notice Status
fields.name: warning_status
fields.instructions: Indicate whether the legally required meeting notice and agenda have been posted. Review the Vermont Open Meeting Law and Town Meeting warning requirements.

fields.label: Virtual Meeting Link
fields.name: virtual_meeting_link
fields.instructions: Public link attendees should use to join the meeting.

fields.label: Agenda
fields.name: agenda
fields.instructions: Choose one source for the agenda. Before publication, confirm the public document is accessible or provide an equivalent accessible path.

sub_fields.label: Agenda Source
sub_fields.name: source
sub_fields.instructions: Choose one source. Only the selected source will be used.

fields.label: Minutes
fields.name: minutes
fields.instructions: Choose one source for the approved minutes. Before publication, confirm the public document is accessible or provide an equivalent accessible path.

sub_fields.label: Minutes Source
sub_fields.name: source
sub_fields.instructions: Choose one source. Only the selected source will be used.

fields.label: Packet / Supporting Documents
fields.name: supporting_documents
fields.instructions: Choose one source per document. Before publication, confirm each public document is accessible or provide an equivalent accessible path.

sub_fields.label: Document Source
sub_fields.name: source
sub_fields.instructions: Choose one source for this document.

fields.label: Long Description
fields.name: long_description
fields.instructions: Full event details for the landing page.

fields.label: Gallery
fields.name: event_gallery
fields.instructions: Optional images for the event landing page. The featured image is managed in the standard Featured Image panel.

fields.label: Cost / Fee
fields.name: cost_or_fee
fields.instructions: Use plain language, such as “Free” or “$10 per person.”

fields.label: Related Documents
fields.name: related_documents
fields.instructions: Choose one source per document. Before publication, confirm each public document is accessible or provide an equivalent accessible path.

sub_fields.label: Document Source
sub_fields.name: source
sub_fields.instructions: Choose one source for this document.

fields.label: Related Event Series
fields.name: related_event_series
fields.instructions: Optional link to the recurring parent event.

description: Structured fields for meetings, programs, community events, closures, repeat schedules, changed dates, and optional event landing pages.
